# Tring

> > Tring is India's leading celebrity engagement platform offering personalized video shoutouts and a comprehensive library of wishes, quotes, and messages for every relationship and occasion.

Tring connects fans with celebrities like Ulka Gupta, Preeti Jhangiani, Sana Saeed, and others for personalized video messages. The platform also provides extensive collections of greeting messages, birthday wishes, anniversary quotes, and romantic texts for relationships including partners, family members, and friends, with special focus on Indian cultural relationships like jiju and bhanji.

## Key Topics

- Celebrity video shoutouts
- Birthday wishes and quotes
- Romantic messages and love texts
- Anniversary wishes for couples
- Good morning and good night messages
- WhatsApp greeting messages
- Relationship advice and quotes
- Farewell and goodbye messages
- Indian family relationships (jiju, bhanji)
- Exam wishes (NEET, JEE, UPSC)
- Celebrity engagement platform
- Personalized video messages
- Girlfriend and boyfriend wishes
- Wedding anniversary quotes
- Family celebration messages
